title: row08
live_proof: inspection in the 3.22.0 tree: sqlite3StartTable() records the table in pSchema->pSeqTab before the CREATE is finalized, sqlite3Prepare's error cleanup calls sqlite3DeleteTable on the same Table, and autoIncBegin later passes pDb->pSchema->pSeqTab to sqlite3OpenTable. Fixed upstream in d4b646997a
object: the sqlite_sequence Table recorded in pSchema->pSeqTab before it was finalized
lifetime_ender: the CREATE fails and sqlite3Prepare's cleanup deletes the Table, leaving pSchema->pSeqTab pointing at freed memory
fidelity: real consumer, real allocator: a failing CREATE of sqlite_sequence followed by AUTOINCREMENT codegen that reads the stale pointer. Reaching the failing CREATE needs writable_schema, which is what the case's name records
